stage: Supplementary post-test diagnostic, not preregistered primary comparison
motivation: Primary physical camera checks passed; unexpected-event neural fits have noisy residuals well above the noise level. Need distinguish optimizer/readout limitations from a proven information deficit.
action: Freeze all learned hidden features and any staged base. Refit only the affine output weights by training-data least squares, SVD rcond=1e-10, for event1/event2 all-order cases at seeds 11,22,33.
selection: No hidden retraining, no data or physics weight retuning, no selection against true source error. Source errors are evaluated and retained after the solve.
scope: Measures attainable measurement loss in frozen features; not optimization of the full robust PINN objective, not a promoted reconstruction, not an independent heldout test.
